sessionSignals.effort: Percentile within sport of the duration-weighted session effort. Rides with normalized power use IF = NP / 300 W (0.55 to 1.02 maps to 0 to 1); other sessions use average HR (105 to 178 bpm), then kcal per hour (300 to 1000).
sessionSignals.variability: Percentile within sport. Variability index NP / average power (1.00 to 1.25) where power exists, otherwise max minus average HR (15 to 60 bpm).
sessionSignals.climb: Strava elevation gain per hour for cycling and running, in meters.
sessionSignals.if: Duration-weighted intensity factor for rides with normalized power.
sessionSignals.hr: Duration-weighted average heart rate in bpm.
